row.title: Production smoke test: claims are probed daily, not trusted
row.body: smoke-live.yml probes the public claims on ultrastable.io and .org daily and files Q-SMOKE items; watchdog and backup-drill land data through scripts/land_data.py (main writer, then PR) because the main writer was refused (Q-MAINWRITER-REFUSED); /api/ask falls back to a cited answer without the model; meta-ingest answers 503 in plain words when storage fails.

title: Production smoke test: claims are probed daily, not trusted
